title: 第15章 还得练第16章 模拟联考
content_zh:
“好。”
答应了虞吟霜，王生便准备离去，时候也不早了。
不过临走前，他不忘礼貌问道：
“那个......老板，不知道怎么称呼您？”
“我姓虞。”
“好的虞老板，那我先回家了。”
虞吟霜微微摇头：
“这个称呼我不喜欢，你还是叫我虞姐姐吧。”
“啊？”王生愣了一下，“哦好，那......再见，虞姐姐。”
说罢，王生拎着自己的背包快步离开了办公室。
就算两世为人，毕竟他还从没真正长大过。
面对这种成熟有魅力的女人，难免会有些局促和不知所措。
随着王生走出拳场，离开地下车库，回到城市街道时，他才逐渐对今天发生的一切有了实感。
第一次挣钱，第一次杀人。
对于杀赵旭的事情，王生倒是没有什么心绪波动，倒不是天生冷血，只是既然杀的是坏人，又何必有什么心理负担？
何况他杀死了我三四回，我才杀他一回，分明是他血赚，我吃亏吧？
想着，王生拿出手机看了下时间，此刻已是将近晚上十二点。
他找了处隐秘的拐角将面具和衣服重新换好后，便打了辆出租回到了家。
凌晨十二点半。
王生打开家门，客厅却是亮着灯，应该是妈妈给他留的。

心中只觉一阵暖意流过，王生关上灯，蹑手蹑脚回到自己房间，将行头小心藏好，便沉沉睡下了。
次日中午。
醒来后的王生，做的第一件事就是从包里拿出一万块钱，递给了母亲顾秀梅。
“儿子......你这是哪儿来的钱？”
顾秀梅十分惊讶。
“我昨天出去兼职给人看场子，帮一个女顾客拦了个酒鬼的骚扰，人家给的小费。”
王生胡诌道。
闻言，顾秀梅是又喜又气，孩子大了知道给家里分担固然值得开心，可看场子和拦醉鬼也太危险了。
顾秀梅无奈教训了儿子一番，但王峰却是出面夸耀称赞虎父无犬子，搞得王生一时有些不知所措。
好在结果是好的，就不再追究，最终夫妻二人合计，一万块里面拿出一千给王生当做零花，五千给他买食补，剩下四千补贴家用。
有了这笔钱，家里最近的一段日子总算是可以好过些了。
content_en:
"Okay."
After agreeing to Yu Yinshuang, Wang Sheng was ready to leave, but it was already getting late.
But before leaving, he did not forget to politely ask:
"Um...boss, I don't know what to call you?"
"My surname is Yu."
"Okay, Boss Yu, I'm going home first."
Yu Yinshuang shook her head slightly:
"I don't like this title. You should call me Sister Yu."
"Ah?" Wang Sheng was stunned for a moment, "Oh, okay, then...goodbye, Sister Yu."
After that, Wang Sheng quickly left the office carrying his backpack.
Even though he has been a human being for two lifetimes, after all, he has never really grown up.
Facing such a mature and charming woman, it is inevitable that you will feel a little embarrassed and at a loss.
As Wang Sheng walked out of the boxing ring, left the underground garage, and returned to the city streets, he gradually came to realize what had happened today.
Making money for the first time, killing people for the first time.
Regarding the killing of Zhao Xu, Wang Sheng didn't have any mood swings. It was not that he was born cold-blooded, but since he was killing a bad guy, why should he have any psychological burden?
What's more, he killed me three or four times, and I only killed him once. It was obviously his blood, and I suffered a loss, right?
Thinking about it, Wang Sheng took out his mobile phone and checked the time. It was almost twelve o'clock in the evening.
He found a hidden corner to change his mask and clothes, then took a taxi and returned home.
It's half past twelve in the morning.
Wang Sheng opened the door, but the light in the living room was on. It should have been left by his mother for him.
Feeling a warmth flow through his heart, Wang Sheng turned off the light, tiptoed back to his room, carefully hid his belongings, and fell asleep.
Noon the next day.
After waking up, the first thing Wang Sheng did was take out 10,000 yuan from his bag and handed it to his mother, Gu Xiumei.
"Son...where did you get your money?"
Gu Xiumei was very surprised.
"I went out to work part-time yesterday to look after the place, and I helped a female customer stop a drunkard from harassing her. I got a tip from her."
Wang Sheng said nonsense.
Hearing this, Gu Xiumei was happy and angry. Although it was nice to know that the children were old enough to share the burden with the family, watching the show and stopping drunks were too dangerous.
Gu Xiumei had no choice but to teach her son a lesson, but Wang Feng came forward to boast and praise the tiger father for having no dog son, which made Wang Sheng a little at a loss.
Fortunately, the result was good, so there was no further pursuit. In the end, the couple combined and gave Wang Sheng one thousand yuan as pocket money, five thousand yuan to buy food supplements for him, and the remaining four thousand yuan to support the family.
With this money, the family's recent life can finally be easier.
